//: Exact operations the backend genuinely SERVES but that are absent from the generated OpenAPI spec. Every entry needs a path, served methods, and a comment naming the mount. Wildcards are forbidden: rewrite-backed aliases are checked against their canonical spec operations instead of being silenced here. This file is NOT for hiding a 404.

entries.comment: Development-only patient login, mounted by a conditional dynamic import that runs ONLY when ENABLE_DEV_AUTH=true. The spec generator boots the app without that flag, so this exact POST is legitimately absent from the spec while still being served wherever it is enabled.
